## Column Notes
### "Auto-induces constraints from paper protocol"
This is the core novelty axis. No surveyed system automatically compiles a
scientific paper's protocol statements into machine-checkable execution
constraints. P-PLAN uses hand-specified operational constraints. Validity
Constraints 2024 uses formal data-lineage constraints
scientific-protocol constraints. LLM workflow generators can produce code
from a paper but do not produce a constraint set that is then checked against
runtime provenance.
### "Constraints are epistemic/scientific rather than operational"
P-PLAN and RO-Crate constraints are operational (did step X run before step Y
does the output file exist). EpiTrace constraints are epistemic: "the reported
score must have been computed by averaging over ALL declared random seeds
column2: the test split must be disjoint from the selection split

column1: must match the published reference." These are properties of the scientific
claim's evidential process
column2: not of the workflow's operational structure.

column1: ### "Supports same-paper/same-code paired discrimination"
No surveyed system is designed to run the same paper/code twice with
different execution histories and discriminate which execution's evidence is
admissible for the claim. R1-A (EpiTrace) does exactly this: 4 papers
paired clean/invalid executions
EpiTrace discriminates via trace.
### "Detects value-preserving violation"
A value-preserving violation is one where Result(T+) ≈ Result(T−) but
EvidenceValidity(T+) ≠ EvidenceValidity(T−). No surveyed system detects this
class. ReproZip checks code consistency
records what happened
column2: not whether it was scientifically admissible.

column1: ### "Validated on natural historical corrections"
R1-C is the only surveyed evaluation that validates against 8 real-world
publicly-documented historical corrections (author errata
reproducibility papers) with a blind pre-prediction protocol. No other
system has a naturalistic external-validation protocol of this kind.

**NOVELTY_STATUS = CLEAR_ENOUGH_FOR_SUBMISSION**
The closest systems are P-PLAN (provenance + constraints
hand-specified) and Validity Constraints 2024 (formal constraints
data-lineage not paper-derived). Neither automatically induces epistemic
constraints from a paper's protocol
